4: "The semuchim" — and see in the Rivash, end of siman 271, where he wrote the matter of the semicha that the Ashkenazim practice. However, it is obvious that this semicha does not help in the present time for matters of dinei kenasos — only for matters of chalitzah and gittin — since there is no semicha for matters of dinei kenasos, as the Rambam wrote in perek 4 of Hilchos Sanhedrin, see there.
